what_happened: Found that review-stack-prepare.sh already implements the exact ref-plumbing idiom ref-plumbing-landing.md's Landing Mechanism section describes, giving the plan a concrete re-point target instead of leaving the pattern doc unanchored after milestone-ref-land.sh is deleted. Also confirmed tasks 691/692/693 (the handoff-printing-review-stack territory) are already [COMPLETED] and never touched the one comment line this record needs to edit in test-milestone-review-handoff.sh, so no ordering/dependency edge is needed.

Every carried figure from the research report re-derived identically at plan-authoring time: all 8 reference sites, every cited line number (manifest 289/440, suite-classification 155, doc citations 9/32/272, test comment 8), all four line counts (244/368/98/324), both index-entries line_count fields (324/98), and review-stack-prepare.sh's commit-tree/update-ref lines (1020/1048/1049/1292/1403). Carried-Figure Discipline cost ~5 minutes of grep instead of a re-research round.

validate-artifact.sh's Tier Justification measurement check emitted two false 'under-verifies' warnings (43 and 8 suites) because the justification block inlined the phase's declared file paths, two of which are themselves test-*.sh files (test-milestone-ref-land.sh, test-milestone-review-handoff.sh). The check's claim extractor greps the whole justification block for 'test-[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\.sh', so a legitimately declared test-file PATH inside a justification is misread as a suite-name CLAIM, flipping claim_kind from empty (out of scope, passed over silently) to suitelist. Worked around by referencing the phase's Files to modify set rather than inlining the paths; plan now passes default and --strict with 0 warnings. Generalizes to any phase whose declared paths include a test suite.

Phase 1's verify-touched.sh scoped run (140 suites, exit 1) surfaced 4 FAILs. 3 are pre-existing/unrelated to this phase's edits: test-gate-cache-equivalence.sh (600s TIMEOUT, likely resource contention under concurrent batch load), test-lint-unit-integration-boundary.sh (3 violations for test-lean-challenge-observe.sh/test-sapience-remember.sh/test-sapience-tag-pending.sh lacking classification rows -- unrelated suites, confirmed not touched by this task), and test-orchestrate-conclusion-roadmap.sh Case H (review-stack-prepare.sh missing beside milestone-review-handoff.sh in its own tmp fixture -- reproduced in isolation on an unmodified checkout, pre-existing fixture gap). The 4th, test-verify-deploy-context-budget.sh, is the EXPECTED deployed-vs-source drift for scripts/tests/suite-classification.data plus two orphan findings for the deleted script/suite -- exactly the intermediate state the plan's own Risk table anticipates and Phase 3's redeploy resolves.
